outcome.technical:
FINDINGS. P148-R18 (med) fixed: one predicate, audit-task.py `_spelling_reach(shape, owner, build, meta)` -> (own, takes_sources), answers 'which paths does the derived gate's own spelling legitimately name'. takes_sources is read off the plan's evidence: a sibling entry (accepted by this project's runner) whose slot - every path it names less the program an interpreter runs, via `_slot_paths` and the shape check's own `_manifest_phases._runs_first_path_as_program` - holds a non-suite path. A recorded `{paths}` spelling holds no example and the phase derivation fills it with suites, so it takes suites. The files arm of `_ordinary_task_gate` points at `[p for p in files if takes_sources or is_suite_path(p)]`; `_rederive_gate` (scope) goes through the same arm, so the scope rewrite is fixed by the same change. P148-R19 (med) fixed by the same predicate: `own` now holds the paths of the always entries `_point` leads a recorded-spelling gate with, and `_files_gate_refusal` asks `_spelling_reach` instead of building `own` from the template alone (and returns None under a sources-taking slot). P148-R20 fixed: `_gate_follows_scope` reads `not _started(node)` (status not pending OR attempts > 0), docstring says so. P148-R21 fixed: `_release_findings(assembled, tids)` walks every phase like `_unresolve_findings` and returns (phase_ids, changes); `_locked_cancel` snapshots and writes every phase it freed a finding in (same loop shape as reopen). P148-R24 fixed: the four places (schema gateBasis description, _manifest_vocab.py comment, commands/init.md, reference/verbs-in-full.md) now define files-no-suite as any task's word, naming the spelling-takes-source exception. P148-R28 fixed: the `audit-task.py --selftest` usage line deleted (the verb exits 2 on it) and _proposals.py's 'which is what `--selftest` here points at' clause removed.
CASES (tests/test_audit_task.py, at7/fd/rf blocks; tests/test__manifest_vocab.py): dg5 (related-tests sibling, add -> ['npx jest --findRelatedTests src/Card.tsx'] basis files), dg5b (scope --files keeps it narrow over both files), dg5c ALLOW (sibling `python3 tools/runner.py tests/test_other.py`: program is not slot, doc+source files -> wide, files-no-suite), dg6 (always ['sh tools/check.sh'] + spelling 'pytest {paths}', --files tools/check.sh,tests/test_check.py -> exit 0, gate ['sh tools/check.sh','pytest tests/test_check.py']), dg6b ALLOW (refusal still names docs/x.md, not tools/check.sh), dg7 (pending task with attempts 1 keeps its gate on scope --tests-add; dg4 is the other direction), fd10 (fix task moved P1->P2 then cancelled frees P1-R1, journal change row), mv67 (no sentence naming files-no-suite in the four texts says 'fix task'; each still names it), rf3 (both docstrings mention --selftest only in the 'no `--selftest`' sentence; `run(['--selftest'])` exits 2).
MUTATIONS (scratch copy of the tree, restored by cp+cmp, __pycache__ purged each run): program kept in slot -> dg5c red; takes_sources forced True -> dg3, dg3b, dg4c, dg7, dg5c, dg6, dg6b red; always paths dropped from own -> dg6, dg6b red; refusal counting every declared file as own -> dg6b red; status-only follows-scope -> dg7 red; release reading only the task's current phase -> fd10 red (fd9 stays green: single phase).
